item.title: Third round of PQC algorithms faces AI threat
item.summary: A new phase in post-quantum cryptography (PQC) is underway, with the field of candidate digital signature algorithms narrowing just as AI systems begin to expose weaknesses in the very schemes designed to withstand quantum attacks.
